content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fairfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma—and the corresponding hours of project-management experience required. Granite PM Academy can help clarify whether you meet the criteria before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led course covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world applications across project-driven industries. All sessions are conducted online, giving you the flexibility to learn while maintaining your current role in Healthcare, Government, Manufacturing, or another Fairfield-area sector.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of education, project experience, and your course completion certificate from Granite PM Academy. Pay the PMI exam fee at the time of application. PMI will review and approve your application before you can schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guidance to reinforce what you learned in class. When ready, schedule your exam through Pearson VUE. The PMP is a computer-based test administered at testing centers and, in some cases, proctored remotely—choose the format that works best for your schedule.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After you earn your PMP, you must renew it every three years by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, professional practice, or giving back to the project-management community. PMI offers numerous ways to earn PDUs, keeping your credential current and your expertise aligned with industry standards throughout your career.
